Thanks for the quote and the quick recap. A couple of points from procurement/finance:

   - Stargazer, Inc. (US parent) — US invoices
   - Stargazer EU Operations Ltd. — EU/EMEA invoices (for entities operating in EU)

If split invoicing is not feasible we will route a single PO to the US parent and provide intercompany journal entries internally.

3) Our finance team also needs an EU VAT certificate for Redwood on file before they process the EU-directed PO. I’ve attached the contact for our AP team and cc’d procurement.

PO workflow: procurement@stargazer.com will raise PO(s) and provide numbers once we confirm you can handle split invoicing and provide the EU VAT cert.

Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow? If you can’t support split invoices, please say so and we’ll proceed with a single PO to Stargazer, Inc.

Best,
